_doc: WP12 (0.14.53) DESIGN-R2 F3/G1.3: one vector set for every --version parser of the pre-swap/rotation run check. Each entry is a full stdout text; parsers take its first line (cut at CR or LF). {V} = the version under test, {OTHER} = a different version. Readers: src-tauri/src/main.rs binprobe tests (H) and cysjavis-pack/bin/tests/test_dept_rotate_binprobe.py (cys-dept shell twin, which pairs each line with the good line of the other binary). The installer parser (nsis-hooks.nsh CYS_PROBE_LEAF) is pinned structurally in scripts/tests/nsis-hook-model/model.py.

accept:
cysd {V} (build 0123456789ab)
cysd {V} (build unknown)
cysd {V} (build x)
cysd {V} (build a-b_c.d+e~!)
second line ignored
reject:
cysd {V} (build x)
cysd {OTHER} (build x)
cysd {V}0 (build x)
cysd {V}
cysd {V} (build )
cysd {V} (build x) trailing
cysd {V} (build a b)
cysd {V} (build a)b)
cysd {V} (build a	b)
cysd {V} (build é)
CYSD {V} (build x)
 cysd {V} (build x)
cysd  {V} (build x)
